verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents managing and receiving cash in USD, EUR, GBP and CAD through one business account, with multi-currency balance storage (jeeves-docs-25, jeeves-docs-5, jeeves-docs-38). The Boleto/Bolepix API adds a BRL collection mechanism (jeeves-docs-32). However, no evidence explicitly says founders get local account details (e.g., local account/routing numbers, IBANs, sort codes) per currency, so the 'local account details' element is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-currency local receiving account details, how inbound local transfers work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
